lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset represents approximately 5.0 million mapped buildings with an average data age of 6 years, with 16% of features added or updated within the last 6 months. Data is provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, KML) for disaster risk exposure assessment.
